messages.subject: amat element error
parts:
Hi Nick

I have prepared a time-stratified analysis.  I have checked the input data, the matrices and everything else, however I still have the following error on the test of likelihood calculations, which I have not been able to fix:


Error in rcpp_states_list_to_DEmat(areas_list = allareas_list, states_list = all_states_list[states_to_use_TF],  : 
  unused argument(s) (amat = amat)


Called from: calc_loglike_for_optim_stratified(params = params, BioGeoBEARS_run_object = inputs, phy = phy, tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state = tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state,   print_optim = TRUE, areas_list = areas_list, states_list = states_list, 
    force_sparse = force_sparse, cluster_already_open = cluster_already_open)

Any advice is welcome.

Best regards

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] amat element error
parts:
That's weird, amat should have a default of null and it is used in the version I am looking at. Maybe make sure you have the newest cladoRcpp off of CRAN? And this might require having the newest version of R installed?

Cheers,
Nick
